behaviors.description: Generate expansive continuous brown-rock upper caves joined to blue-rock Depths, sharing the geological boundary with presentation, player support/contact and sound. Adapt pre-binary Cardinal cave proportions and configured original atlas colors without block storage.
behaviors.selection: Procedures/caves.json selects legacy_perlin: the older 64/128-metre two-field shape, a three-metre roof and 1024-metre local radius, overlapping the existing -20..-64 Depths field by four metres. Authored tunnels/chambers remain connected. The previous bounded value_noise alternative and marching tetrahedra remain explicitly selectable. Surface-net rendering and collision query the same field; mesh/contact remain bounded numerical approximations. Underground surface-net windows widen to 72 metres below -18 metres to include the main chamber walls; near-surface windows remain 36 metres. River air is capped by its shoreline margin so the extracted bank approaches the shared material boundary. Deep underground views render the cave volume with a 24..34-metre dark visibility fade and omit the outdoor height-field, theatre and surface vegetation; finite mesh boundaries are not presented as exposed sky. This is a bounded visibility treatment, not infinite cave rendering. The November cave expansion adds three authored surface routes and three distinct chamber proportions. Independently meshed Blender formations extend the shared collision/material volume; explicit fine meshes preserve their silhouettes without changing the geological extraction spacing. The original route and brown/blue rock distinction remain.

checks.expectation: The entrance joins a descending tunnel and Depths chambers without cubic world cells. Display and collision query the same continuous solid. Existing save edits are retained. Sampling and body contact are bounded prototype approximations.
checks.procedure: Run cave field, meshing, shared collision and traversal-route checks; inspect upper/Depths material assignment and native shader validation. Human gameplay assessment of entrance continuity, ceiling contact, dark chamber visibility and mobile performance remains required.

checks.expectation: Geological void generation does not count as excavation. No direct delete-volume hook is exposed; future underground removal must be committed from accepted tool/material response and account for detached mass.
checks.procedure: Review registered hooks and later integrate material separation before claiming player-driven underground excavation.

checks.expectation: Geometric upper bounds skip only noise terms that cannot change the continuous field maximum; original cave and river surfaces remain unchanged.
checks.procedure: Run capped_noise_rejection_preserves_original_field_bits and existing underground mesh, support, surface cover and terrain acoustic regressions. Compare cold scene preparation separately from steady frames.

checks.expectation: Stalagmites and stalactites attach to sampled chamber floors/ceilings, keep route centerlines clear, and expose ruby/silver above the Depths and blue/magenta crystals below. Accepted mining domains remove formation volume and faces; refined material retains its mineral identity, mass and tint. Existing stone mechanics apply.
checks.procedure: Run cave_formations, cave_mining_checks, underground and deep_cave_view checks. Inspect Blender Preview.png. Native traversal, pickaxe strike/drop interactions, lighting and frame cost require gameplay review.
